paper.title: When Tool Outputs Become Commands: Separating Action Induction from Runtime Authorization in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents

mechanism_passages.supports: SARA scopes authorization state to one task and clears it when that task terminates or is explicitly reset.
K is the task authorization root, F retains action-inducing origins, and H retains audited successful execution evidence.

mechanism_passages.section: 4.4 Evidence-Driven Authorization at the Execution Boundary
mechanism_passages.supports: H stores allowed successful calls and observations and is consulted for execution-chain and argument support.

boundary: The source is independently authored. Every executable SARA component in this experiment is an OpenLine paper-spec reconstruction.
